name: n7hr1a-cos-delivery
goal: Chief of Staff alerts are submitted and receipted by the Tracker itself; stuck delivery raises a tracker ask that needs no tmux pane

evidence: Live: since 24 Nov 17:24Z every CoS alert nudge stayed unsent in the Claude composer and was submitted only by another sender's Enter (30-MIN tick, tunnel messages, /clear), seen in the chief-of-staff Claude transcripts. Reproduced in a private tmux rig with Claude Code 2.1.332: TrackerTmuxAdapter.nudge returned sent:false and the composer held '[Pasted text #1]' with 'paste again to expand'. Expected: submitted and receipted.

The fake tmux in test/adapters/projects-sessions/tracker-tmux.test.ts accepts text and Enter in one command and only models the Codex composer, so Claude's paste-burst behaviour was never modelled. The reusable fixture test/support/claudePasteTmuxFixture.ts keeps an Enter sent with text inside the paste.
